original_definition: IMF Investment and Capital Stock Dataset, 1960-2019
General government investment (gross fixed capital formation), in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
General government capital stock (constructed based on general government investment flows "igov_rppp"), in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
Private investment (gross fixed capital formation), in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
Private capital stock (constructed based on private investment flows "igov_rppp"), in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
Public-private partnership (PPP) investment, in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
Public-private partnership (PPP) capital stock (constructed based on PPP investment flows "ippp_rppp"), in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
Gross domestic product, in billions of constant 2017 international dollars.
General government investment (gross fixed capital formation), in billions of nominal national currency
General government capital stock, in billions of nominal national currency
Private investment (gross fixed capital formation), in billions of nominal national currency
Private capital stock, in billions of nominal national currency
Public-private partnership (PPP) capital stock, in billions of nominal national currency.
Gross domestic product, in billions of nominal national currency
These are country groupings as defined by the IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO): 1=low income developing countries (LIDC); 2=emerging markets (EM); 3=advanced economies (AE).
